cupertino.notes: AUDIT 43 (3): ready to review. The note cites Apple's opaque separator C6C6C8 light and 38383A dark (1.53:1 and 1.45:1 on the grounds, computed); the picture draws EAEAEF on F2F2F7 (1.07:1) and 272729 on 1C1C1E (1.14:1) for the full-width hairline and E5E5E9 / 303032 for Strong, so the drawing is neither the cited value nor visibly present at 1x (full width, inset and vertical cells are nearly invisible, viewed light and dark). Raise it when the hairline is the cited colour. | ROUND 84 (lane y, batch 6, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): raised to ready by the coordinator's standard. Apple separators are hairlines by design (opaque separator C6C6C8 light, 38383A dark): they are decorative and carry no state, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks no 3:1 of them (about 1.1 to 1.5:1 here). All seven cells (full width, inset 56, middle inset 16, labelled, label leading, strong, vertical) are drawn and the labels ('Or') are secondary label colour at 5:1 and better. Viewed light and dark, 1x and 1.5x. | ROUND 85 (lane y, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): AUDIT 43 (4) fixed. The Cupertino rule draws the cited opaque separator colours C6C6C8 (light) and 38383A (dark) one whole pixel thick on whole pixels (1.53:1 and 1.45:1 on the F2F2F7 and 1C1C1E grounds, measured from the picture; at 1.5x a 1.5 px rule, one pixel of it half covered); the strong rule is 8A8A8E / 6C6C70 (3:1 or better). A separator is decorative (WCAG 1.4.11), so 1.5:1 is stated, not claimed as a control. Labelled and vertical cells viewed.
gaps: The hairline is 1.1 to 1.5:1 by design; the Vertical cell is faint
